zh.title: 沙特：拉斯坦努拉炼油厂遭袭，能源出口风险上升
zh.summary: 路透社11月25日报道，胡塞武装宣称袭击拉斯坦努拉炼油厂，知情人士确认发生袭击，卫星影像显示烟雾。
zh.body:
路透社报道，胡塞武装宣称袭击沙特拉斯坦努拉炼油厂，知情人士确认发生袭击，卫星影像显示烟雾。该厂日炼油能力约55万桶，实际生产损失仍待运营方公布。
分析：能源设施持续承压可能提高沙特参与地区冲突的经济成本。企业应区分炼油产品供应与原油出口风险，分别核对供应商交货承诺、港口装运安排及替代采购成本。后续指标包括阿美产能公告、实际装船量和保险费率。

en.title: Saudi Arabia: Ras Tanura refinery attack raises energy export risk
en.summary: Reuters reported on 25 November that the Houthis claimed an attack on Ras Tanura refinery; an informed source confirmed an attack and satellite imagery showed smoke.
en.body:
Reuters reported a Houthi claim of an attack on Ras Tanura refinery, corroborated as an attack by an informed source, with smoke visible in satellite imagery. The facility has approximately 550,000 barrels per day of refining capacity; actual production losses await operator disclosure.
Assessment: Continued pressure on energy infrastructure may increase the economic cost of Saudi involvement in regional conflict. Businesses should distinguish refined-product availability from crude export exposure, checking supplier commitments, loading schedules and alternative procurement costs. Indicators include Aramco capacity updates, actual loadings and insurance premiums.
